_doc: Published reference scores, shown as `ref:` rows by `visbench report`. Values are fractions (paper % / 100) with the citing table in `_source`. LoMa (arXiv 2604.04931) and RoMa v2 (arXiv 2511.15706) rows were checked against the arXiv HTML on 2026-11-01. WxBS mAA differs between papers (RoMa: 72.6 in LoMa vs 60.8 in RoMa v2); the LoMa numbers are used because they share HardMatch's protocol. HardMatch paper numbers use the paper split at 640x640; the released v1.0.0 data changed about 10 pairs and scores at the released 1024-px images, so expect small differences. `_no_published_reference` lists datasets without a canonical table.

_no_published_reference.eth3d: ETH3D high-res used by RoMa-V2 / MASt3R as input but no widely cited per-pair pose-AUC headline.
_no_published_reference.minima_dsec: MINIMA paper reports per-modality numbers but they vary by direction (vis->evt vs evt->vis); see paper Table 2 directly.
_no_published_reference.minima_mmim: Per-subset (medical / remote-sensing) numbers in MINIMA paper; too granular for a single canonical row.
_no_published_reference.minima_md1500_paint: MINIMA Table 3 — MINIMA-LoFTR ~0.40 AUC@5°; full per-method tables are method-specific.
